_doc: Row-block size and vector width for the RMSNorm JIT kernel.
A row is a `match` pattern over arch / mp_count / graph_capture / shape / m_range; an omitted dimension is a wildcard and the most specific match wins.
A row that constrains anything must carry a `note` saying how it was measured; only an all-wildcard row may be generic.
